subject: general
question: The national poverty line for 2011-12 was estimated at _________ per capita per month for urban areas of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 1,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to an** International Monetary Fund** paper, **extreme poverty**, **defined by the World Bank as living on US$1.9 or less in purchasing power parity** (PPP) terms.
 
• According to the Planning Commission in 2011-12, the national poverty line using Tendulkar methology is** Rs 816 per capita per month for rural areas** and **Rs 1000 per capita per month for urban areas of India**. 
 
• The current poverty line is 1,059.42 Indian Rupees per month in rural areas and 1,286 Indian rupees per month in urban areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** POVERTY MEASUREMENT IN INDIA:

 
• Poverty can be defined as a condition in which an individual or household lacks the financial resources to afford a basic minimum standard of living.
 
• India has a long history of studies on measurement of poverty. The erstwhile Planning Commission was the nodal agency in India for estimation of poverty.
 
• Various expert groups constituted by the Planning Commission have estimated the number of people living in poverty in India:
 
 
• Working Group (1962).
 
• Study by VM Dandekar and N Rath (1971).
 
• Task Force on “Projections of Minimum Needs and Effective Consumption Demand” headed by Dr. Y. K. Alagh (1979).
 
• Lakdawala Expert Group (1993): Headed by Professor D.T. Lakdawala.
 
• Tendulkar Expert Group (2009): It was setup in 2005 and was headed by Suresh Tendulkar.
 
• Rangrajan Committee (2014): It was set up in 2012 and was headed by Chakravarthi Rangarajan.
